headlines.title: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger data
headlines.summary: Job cuts are at a four-year low, according to Challenger Grey data illustrating the over 500,000 job cuts that have occurred in 2026 year-to-date. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to take a closer look and this data discuss whether AI-driven job loss fears were initially overblown. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is scheduled to release August jobs data on Friday, September 4.

headlines.title: Uber Technologies (UBER) Cuts 3,300 Jobs As Investors Reassess Its Valuation
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) has just announced a restructuring that will cut about 3,300 jobs, or roughly 10% of its global workforce, as it trims management layers and consolidates teams. For investors, the restructuring headlines are landing against a mixed share price backdrop, with a 30 day share price return of 6.76% and a year to date share price decline of 7.74%, while total shareholder return is down 17.74% over one year but still up over three and five years.

headlines.title: Uber Is Cutting 10% of Its Workforce and Betting $10 Billion on Robotaxis Instead
headlines.summary: Uber is slashing thousands of jobs and pouring billions into self-driving cars it will never actually build. Whether that bet saves the company or slowly hands its future to someone else is the real question.

headlines.title: Vietnamese Rival To Uber, Lyft Plans To Enter U.S. Market This Year
headlines.summary: The VinFast-linked rideshare company GSM plans to enter the U.S. market by the end of this year, the company said.

headlines.title: Down 6% in 2026, Uber Is Slashing Another 10% of Its Workforce
headlines.summary: Uber just announced its biggest round of layoffs since the pandemic, yet analysts are pointing to targets more than 30% above the current price. Here is what the bulls and bears are each getting right.

description: Uber Technologies, Inc. develops and operates proprietary technology applications in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment connects consumers with a range of transportation modalities, such as ridesharing, carsharing, micromobility, rentals, public transit, taxis, and other modalities; and offers riders in a variety of vehicle types, as well as financial partnerships products and advertising services. The Delivery segment allows consumers to search for and discover restaurants to grocery, alcohol, convenience, and other retailers, as well as order a meal or other items, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have it delivered; and provides Uber direct, a white-label delivery-as-a-service for retailers and restaurants, as well as advertising services. The Freight segment manages transportation and logistics networks, which connects shippers and carriers in digital marketplace, including carriers upfronts, pricing, and shipment booking; and offers on-demand platform to automate logistics end-to-end transactions for small-and medium-sized businesses to global enterprises. Uber Technologies, Inc. has staetegic partnership with Mews to embed ride booking, real-time tracking and integrated billing directly into the Mews platform. The company was formerly known as Ubercab, Inc. and changed its name to Uber Technologies, Inc. in February 2011. Uber Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
